name: The Star Toad Constellary
description: A color-and-constellation system used by Toad communities to record vocation, memory, mutual-aid obligations, and Star Toad resonance without turning cap color into destiny.
principles: Cap color is heritage and association, not a biological caste or moral category.
A Toad may belong to several constellations over a lifetime.
Star Toads are recognized by resonance, service, and community witness—not by a single color.
Every constellation grants a social role and a burden; there are no cost-free archetypes.

capColors.name: Red Cap
capColors.burden: being expected to stand first and recover quietly

capColors.name: Yellow Cap
capColors.association: building, craft, food stores, sunlight rites
capColors.strength: making shelter and supply from little

capColors.name: Green Cap
capColors.strength: seeing a safe path before others do

capColors.name: Purple Cap
capColors.burden: being suspected of knowing too much

capColors.strength: turning grief into a shared language
capColors.burden: being asked to make suffering beautiful

starToad.definition: A Toad whose cap, voice, or presence resonates with the Star Road and whose community recognizes them as a route-maker between isolated people.
starToad.notAChosenOne: Star Toads are not automatically royal, powerful, pure, or destined. The title can be earned, inherited, disputed, or refused.
practices: turning local memories into navigable maps
abilities: Star Sighting: reveal a safe route or hidden connection when a community contributes a memory
Constellation Call: coordinate allied Toads across a map once three witnesses agree on the signal
Falling Star: spend stored mutual-aid credit to protect one person from an otherwise certain consequence
limits: a Star Toad cannot create trust where no one will answer
each use requires a witness, memory, or material contribution
false constellations form when leaders erase inconvenient names
the system weakens when communities are isolated or coerced
storyHooks: a star map has a missing village deliberately scratched out
two cap communities claim the same constellation and its resources
a Star Toad refuses a royal summons to guide refugees instead
the party must decide whether to reveal a safe route that an army could exploit

systemHooks.reputation: Aid given to Toad communities creates constellation credit; exploitation creates broken-star markers.
systemHooks.events: Cap-color customs and Star Toad vigils can unlock events, quests, and alternate dialogue.
systemHooks.battles: Toad cohorts can provide route intelligence, evacuation lanes, field kitchens, or morale—never generic interchangeable infantry.
systemHooks.characters: Characters may have a cap association, constellation membership, and a personal stance toward the system.
systemHooks.maps: Star routes connect refuges, wells, kitchens, observatories, and hidden roads as a social map layer.

sourceNote: Original setting synthesis based on the project’s Toad entries and the supplied Star Toad reference image; color associations are local worldbuilding, not biological rules.
